newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Imaging wins two contracts.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Imaging wins two contracts.

text.p: Alliance Imaging Inc, a supplier of radiology and diagnostic imaging systems, on Wednesday said it signed two hospitals to seven-year contracts for full-time magnetic resonance imaging systems and services.
The two hospitals are Washington Hospital in Fremont, Calif., amd CGH Medical Center in Sterling, Ill.

Alliance will install a 1.5 Tesla MRI system at Washington Hospital in 1997's second quarter with revenues expected by the third quarter. CGH Medical Center plans to receive a 1.5 Tesla MRI system in the fourth quarter.
